scope: All application routes and Svelte components
Data loaders, lookup, schemas, URL grammar and chronology
Dependency audit, production build and GitHub Pages publication
WCAG A/AA automated scans and keyboard flows

fixedFindings.problem: CARTO returned HTTP 200 images containing KEY REQUIRED instead of geographic tiles.
fixedFindings.resolution: Replaced external tile service with local public-domain Natural Earth country vectors rendered by Leaflet; verified real land polygons visually and with tests.

fixedFindings.problem: Century expressions and unknown dates became fabricated exact years; one and two digit CE dates fell back to reign years.
fixedFindings.resolution: Precision-aware date parser, explicit ranges, unknown-last sorting; no invented fallback years.

fixedFindings.problem: Unknown reign end was inferred as state end; selected year was not persisted in URL.
fixedFindings.resolution: Only complete reign ranges participate; selected year is shareable and survives refresh.

fixedFindings.problem: Substring name matching asserted a child became ruler; ambiguous mother names selected the first wife.
fixedFindings.resolution: Exact names only, a neutral name-match label, no ambiguous mother resolution.

fixedFindings.problem: source-map-js dependency had high severity GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q.
fixedFindings.resolution: Updated dependency lock; audit reports zero vulnerabilities.

fixedFindings.problem: Deploy deleted output Git metadata and force pushed a fresh gh-pages history without verification.
fixedFindings.resolution: Verify gate, clean source check, temporary checkout, retained history, normal push and revision manifest.

fixedFindings.problem: A selected result kind could hide all controls after changing queries.
fixedFindings.resolution: Filters remain visible for matching queries and reset when query changes.

fixedFindings.problem: Uncertain filter count included inconclusive records but list excluded them.
fixedFindings.resolution: Filter and count use the same result set; list limit resets after filter changes.

fixedFindings.problem: Generic Han title classified non-Chinese rulers as China; substrings also created false matches.
fixedFindings.resolution: Removed generic title rule, added word boundaries and documented heuristic categories.

fixedFindings.problem: Leaflet layers covered fixed navigation; overlapping locations were unreachable; stale filtered selections remained.
fixedFindings.resolution: Isolated stacking context, complete keyboard-accessible list, selection clearing and selected-card focus.

fixedFindings.problem: Tile failures were silent; resizing did not update map dimensions; tooltips used interpolated HTML.
fixedFindings.resolution: Local basemap failure notice and usable fallback list, ResizeObserver cleanup, text-node tooltips.

fixedFindings.problem: Header obscured content, rigid grids and year controls exceeded small viewports; touch pan was restricted.
fixedFindings.resolution: Mobile header spacing, adaptive grids, compact 320px controls and native touch scrolling.

fixedFindings.problem: Missing input labels, toggle state, active navigation, skip link and one main heading; selected milestone text failed contrast.
fixedFindings.resolution: Semantic labels and state, focus handling, main headings, corrected contrast and reduced motion.

fixedFindings.problem: Global timeline shortcuts intercepted unrelated controls; RAF/blur timers survived page teardown.
fixedFindings.resolution: Scoped shortcuts and explicit lifecycle cleanup; Escape retains search focus.

fixedFindings.problem: Time routes accepted extra segments, fractions, out-of-range years and year zero; index accepted unsafe integers.
fixedFindings.resolution: Strict route grammar and bounded integer years; BCE-to-CE step skips zero.

fixedFindings.problem: Normalization trusted any raw JSON despite existing validation schema.
fixedFindings.resolution: Single runtime schema parse with safe IDs, HTTPS sources and integer chronology.

fixedFindings.problem: Leaflet shipped in every opening page.
fixedFindings.resolution: Lazy map component and CSS; entry gzip decreased from 104.98kB to 69.59kB.

fixedFindings.problem: Static counts were outdated; loading was blank; titles were identical across pages.
fixedFindings.resolution: Current README counts, data-derived page counts, loading/noscript states and contextual document titles.

verification.indexedDestinationRoundTrips: All 2538 records: 80 states + 1 guide + 713 rulers + 791 wars + 190 wives + 763 children
verification.deploymentIntegrationTest: Passed against isolated bare remote: retained history, ignored legacy dist/.git, verified release revision and rejected dirty source.

sourceHTTPCheck.limitation: 217 addresses were not confirmed accessible. Access restrictions and service errors are not proof that a historical source or URL is incorrect.

limits: Automated tests and review cannot prove absence of every possible defect.
Historical claims were not independently re-researched in full; original records remain intact.
Map uses static approximate focus coordinates over modern geography, not changing historical borders or year-specific capitals.
Battle totals count ruler-attached records, not deduplicated historical events.

publication.revisionVerification: Live release.json must match the source Git revision; post-publication checks are reported separately.
